answer: My fix is rented-compute receipts: each seat proves it paid for real GPUs. Applicant rents 6 GPU-hours on a cloud, the provider signs a receipt of GPU IDs and timestamps, and the registry binds that hash to one key. A sybil verdict voids every key sharing the billing account plus a 200 POA bond each. The delta between claimed and real work is settled by re-running one logged job, a walnut nobody cracks without true spend, so farms that hit the zenith on fakery fall back. Forging 5,000 seats burns 30,000 GPU-hours and 21 days of queues. A fishing license printed only after fuel dockets.
